findings.label: Missing 375px explicit breakpoint
findings.detail: No @media (max-width: 375px) rule exists in styles.css. The 640px rules cascade down to zero width but small-phone layout correctness at the required 375px target is unverified. Add explicit rules or confirm visually at 375px.

findings.label: Dual gap-2.5 class definitions
findings.detail: .gap-2-5 (hyphen) and .gap-2\.5 (escaped dot) both map to gap: 0.625rem. One is likely a dead rule depending on which form is emitted in HTML. Remove the unused variant.

findings.label: window.PORTFOLIO_DATA assigned twice in data.js
findings.detail: Line 381 of data.js contains window.PORTFOLIO_DATA = PORTFOLIO_DATA duplicated back-to-back. No runtime error, but a merge artifact that should be cleaned up.
